text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a quick base-image trim for the runtime nodes this week. Goal is to cut down attack surface + remove a bunch of unused packages that keep tripping our vuln scans. Also need to coordinate KMS key access and audit logging. anyone available for quick sync?

sam: +1. did the vuln scan flag anything critical or is this mainly hygiene?

maria: Mostly hygiene but there is one moderate CVE in libarchive that's pulled in via old tar package. Not exploitable in our runtime directly AFAICT, but want to reduce blast radius.

lee: For the KMS part, the build/publish SA needs kms:Encrypt,Decrypt,CreateGrant on the image-signing key. We'll also need to add a short-lived grant flow for CI to avoid long-lived creds.

jordan: We should also lock down image pull RBAC: only nodes in the runtime nodepool + our rollout job principal. And enable audit logs for image registry events for 90 days at least.

maria: Agree. Proposed plan: 1) rebase to distroless-minimal 2) strip package manager 3) generate SBOM and attestation 4) sign image with KMS key 5) canary deploy + rollouts.

sam: Sounds good. distroless will likely break any exec/bash tests. Are we prepared to run integration smoke with the new image?

maria: We'll run the smoke suite and the healthcheck harness. No interactive shells in production so should be fine.

lee: IAM snippet for the build SA (example):
```json
{
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:CreateGrant"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/build-image"}
}
```
You'll want to deny kms:CreateKey and limit Grants with Condition for GrantIsForAWSService if available.

jordan: For audit logs, we'll need to add a parsing rule in SIEM to link image digest => pod_id => request_id. Add a correlation id header in the runtime manifest so logs surface a trace id.

maria: CI flow: build -> SBOM -> trivy scan -> attest -> sign -> push. Can we make attestation a gating check on deploy?

sam: yes. Attestation service can write to attestations bucket and CI will fail if missing. I'll add a job in our pipeline.

ci-bot: Build #2934 started for runtime-base:distroless-2026-03-20.

ci-bot: Build #2934: trivy scan: FOUND 1 MEDIUM (libarchive).

maria: ok that's the one. mitigation: drop the package or update to patched lib, but distroless doesn't include tar by default so that should resolve.

lee: KMS key alias: alias/redd-runtime-signing. Key policy needs to allow aws:ViaService for ecr.amazonaws.com if we do ECR signing. I'll drop a PR to the key policy repo.

jordan: Deployment strategy: canary to 5% for 30 minutes, if error-rate > 1% or p99 latency regresses by > 50ms roll back. Also set pod disruption budget to allow rolling update with maxUnavailable: 1.

maria: What about downtime for the internal admin consoles? They have older healthchecks.

sam: We'll run a separate job for admin console pods with readinessProbe tweaks and pre-pull the image onto nodes to avoid cold-start. No planned downtime.

lee: Note on RBAC: clusterrolebinding for the rollout job should be scoped to the namespace and annotated with purpose + owner for audit. Example annotation: "rebase:2026-03-20,owner:maria"

maria: Checklist so far (copying here):
- SBOM generated and uploaded
- trivy/clair scan results attached
- Attestation present and signed by alias/redd-runtime-signing
- Key policy PR merged for build role grants
- Registry audit logging enabled and SIEM parsing rule configured
- Canary rollout config + alerting runbook updated
- PodDisruptionBudget set, readiness/liveness probes validated
- Smoke/integration tests green

sam: I'll own build + attestation job. target to have build + SBOM by EOD Tue.

lee: I'll open the key policy PR and add the KMS grant flow docs.

jordan: I'll add SIEM parsing rule and the canary alert (pager duty). Also update the rollback runbook with the correlation-id steps.

maria: Sweet. final question—any blockers for signing with KMS? We use HSM-backed key but need to ensure grants can be created from CI without exposing key ARN. Lee?

lee: We can use CreateGrant with RetiringPrincipal set to the signing service role and auto-revoke after 1 hour. CI will call CreateGrant, use it for Sign, then retire the grant. No need to surface the key material.

maria: Perfect. Let's meet briefly tomorrow 09:30 to do final go/no-go and schedule the canary for Wednesday 02:00 UTC. If anyone sees issues in the meantime drop them here. :thumbsup:

sam: 👍

jordan: 👍

lee: 👍

ci-bot: Build #2934: completed (attestation attached, trivy MEDIUM noted).
